Fine stroke density and quiet color must match a dark ink hair family.
Return ONLY the fresh isolated front-hair sprite with native real alpha, clean tapered edges, fully transparent surrounding area and face opening. No background, shadow, halo, fog, checkerboard, text, guides or swatches.
